name: cache-keeper
description: Band above the prompt: prompt-cache time left, Warm button, keep warm for 10 h unattended, and a Handoff button suggested when the session goes off track (signals judge vs model judge, compared over 5 sessions).

ttlMinutes.title: Cache TTL (minutes)
ttlMinutes.description: Prompt-cache lifetime of this session: 60 for the 1-hour cache, 5 for the 5-minute one.

keepHours.title: Keep-warm hours
keepHours.description: How long Keep warm pings an unattended session.

inputUsdPerMTok.title: Input price (USD per million tokens)
inputUsdPerMTok.description: Base input price of the session model; cache read is 0.1x, 1-hour cache write 2x, output 5x.

handoffDir.title: Handoff folder
handoffDir.description: Folder the handoff file is written to; empty means the current working directory.
